title: Pixel Difference Networks for Efficient Edge Detection (PiDiNet)
mechanism: Pixel difference convolutions fold classic gradient operators into conv layers, giving an accurate edge detector under 1M params trained from scratch.
adaptation: Swap the 3x3 convs in the first two ResNet-34 stages for PDC variants, or add a full-resolution PDC side branch fused into the U-Net++ decoder. Crack and gridline contrast are local intensity differences, and 7% of cracks are under 2% darker than their surroundings. Also a lightweight member of the benchmark suite.
min_experiment: Arm: house + PDC side branch, 5 seeds. Baseline: house at 100% labels. Metrics: crack recall at fixed relP@2, gridline IoU, E1 relF1@2. Kill if all are n.d.
evidence: R: BSDS500 ODS 0.807 at 100 FPS with under 1M params; a variant under 0.1M params runs at 200 FPS.
prior_overlap: Only the ResNet-34/50 U-Net++ backbones were tested. Open.

alt_notes.adaptation: PDC side branch on the raw 1-channel EL image fused into the U-Net++ decoder at full resolution, or PDC stem convs, to boost low-contrast cracks (7% under 2% darker) and gridlines. Also the light benchmark member.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house + PDC full-res branch, 5 seeds; baseline house. Metrics crack IoU, gridline IoU, relF1@2. Kill if all n.d. About 8 GPU-h.
